method: Full-field editorial translation with era-specific historical research; not an independent scholarly certification.

sourceExceptions.reason: Never elected to office interpreted as President/VP entering White House; Ford had won House elections. Same reading at 24 and 25.
1973 grain-start year retained despite July 1972 agreement; annotated.
873 electoral votes and fantastical events retained as original absurdist ending, not historical results.

revisions.source: President Gerald Ford attempts to win election to office after replacing Richard Nixon in 1974, and narrowly defeating Ronald Reagan for the Republican nomination. Jimmy Carter is a new face on the national scene, having served as Governor of Georgia. He will make the case that the nation needs new blood after the scandals of the Nixon era. Both candidates are seen as moderate by the standards of their party. The battleground states are in the West, the Midwest, and the Northeast.
revisions.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特总统在1974年接替理查德·尼克松后，如今争取通过选举继续执政；他刚刚险胜罗纳德·里根，取得共和党提名。曾任佐治亚州州长的吉米·卡特，是全国政坛的新面孔。他将主张，经历尼克松时代的丑闻后，国家需要新鲜血液。按各自党内的标准，两位候选人都被视为温和派。西部、中西部和东北部各州，将是争夺的主战场。

revisions.source: Jimmy Carter has served as Governor of Georgia for one term, and has never held an elected office in Washington. In an era of public disgust with Watergate, Vietnam, and the economy, Carter has used his outsider status to win the Democratic nomination. He is an outspoken Southern Baptist, and a moderate within the party on social and economic issues. He begins with an early lead in the polls against Gerald Ford.
revisions.zh: 吉米·卡特担任过一届佐治亚州州长，从未在华盛顿担任过民选职务。公众厌恶水门事件、越南战争和糟糕的经济，卡特凭借局外人的身份赢得了民主党提名。他公开表达自己的美南浸信会信仰，在社会和经济议题上属于党内温和派。竞选开始时，他在民调中领先杰拉尔德·福特。

revisions.source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1976 Presidential Election.

Hopefully you can make good on your promises to clean up Washington and change the political and moral culture of the country. If you are successful, there is no reason you cannot run for reelection in 1980. Just be wary of any economic problems, or of some foreign policy crisis that could dent your popularity.
revisions.zh:
恭喜！你赢得了1976年总统选举。

希望你能兑现整顿华盛顿、改变国家政治和道德风气的承诺。如果成功，你完全可以在1980年争取连任。不过，要当心经济问题，或可能损害你声望的外交危机。

revisions.source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.

As an outsider candidate, this was really your moment to make an impact on American politics and to win a national election. The beltway gossip already has it that Ted Kennedy is the frontrunner for the 1980 nomination. Perhaps you can run again for Governor of Georgia, or make an impact in some other way.
revisions.zh:
很遗憾，你输掉了1976年总统选举。

作为局外人候选人，这本是你影响美国政治、赢得全国选举的大好时机。华盛顿政界的传闻已经说，特德·肯尼迪是1980年提名的领跑者。或许，你可以再次竞选佐治亚州州长，或通过其他方式发挥影响。

revisions.source:
Wow! You have won in a squeaker.

While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect you in that manner. Hopefully the closeness of this election doesn't undermine your promises to clean up Washington and unite the people of this country.
revisions.zh:
哇！你险胜了。

选举人团虽然打成平局，但民主党在众议院拥有巨大优势，肯定会通过众议院选举让你当选。希望这场如此接近的选举，不会削弱你整顿华盛顿、团结全国人民的承诺。

revisions.source:
Congratulations! You have won the 1976 Presidential Election.

Hopefully you can continue to help the United States recover from the Watergate Scandal, the recent recession, and the debacle of Vietnam. In either case, this will be your final term as President. Speculation is sure to be intense on who will replace you. Will it be Ronald Reagan? Ted Kennedy? Or someone else entirely?
revisions.zh:
恭喜！你赢得了1976年总统选举。

希望你能继续帮助美国从水门丑闻、最近的衰退和越南的惨败中恢复。无论如何，这都将是你担任总统的最后一个任期。谁会接替你，必定引发热烈猜测。是罗纳德·里根？特德·肯尼迪？还是完全不同的某个人？

revisions.source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.

Hopefully your opponent can make good on his promises to clean up Washington and change the political and moral culture of the country. Perhaps you can still play a role in 1980, or seek your old Congressional leadership positions. In any case, you can still take solace in the fact that you did the right thing by pardoning Nixon and moving the country beyond the Watergate episode.
revisions.zh:
很遗憾，你输掉了1976年总统选举。

希望你的对手能兑现整顿华盛顿、改变国家政治和道德风气的承诺。也许你在1980年仍能发挥作用，或者争取回到原先的国会领导职位。无论如何，你仍可以安慰自己：赦免尼克松、让国家走出水门事件，是做了正确的事。

revisions.source:
Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.

While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect your opponent in that manner. Perhaps you can still play a role in 1980, or seek your old Congressional leadership positions. In any case, you can still take solace in the fact that you did the right thing by pardoning Nixon and moving the country beyond the Watergate episode.
revisions.zh:
很遗憾，你输掉了1976年总统选举。

选举人团虽然打成平局，但民主党在众议院拥有巨大优势，肯定会通过众议院选举让你的对手当选。也许你在1980年仍能发挥作用，或者争取回到原先的国会领导职位。无论如何，你仍可以安慰自己：赦免尼克松、让国家走出水门事件，是做了正确的事。

revisions.source: Sorry, you lost the 1976 election.
revisions.zh: 很遗憾，你输掉了1976年选举。

revisions.source: I can't fuckin think of anything funny for Ford, he is so bland, just pretend this gif is playing and he is falling down the stairs.
revisions.zh: 我他妈真想不出福特有什么好笑的。他实在太无趣了，你就假装那个动图正在播放，他正从楼梯上摔下来吧。

revisions.source: The year is 1984
revisions.zh: 现在是1984年。

revisions.source: Jimmy Carter has been president for 8 years. Inflation has subsided to a steady amount, with unemployment dropping to virtually 0%. The budget had been balanced in 78, and poverty and hunger have been eradicated, as everyone unemployed became a farmer, and is eating peanut butter and peach jam sandwiches. the USSR on the 21st of January had seceded all their land to the USA and declared their government dissolved. Most importantly of all, the government is now trusted more than ever under the leadership of Jimmy Carter, who beat up Richard Nixon on live TV in 1981, garnering a 99% approval rating. Mondale has already won the most recent election 873 electoral votes to 0 against those sorry Republicans, who disbanded shortly after. All is good in the world, thanks to our wonderful leader, Jimmy Carter.
revisions.zh: 吉米·卡特已经当了八年总统。通胀降至稳定水平，失业率几乎降到0%。预算早在1978年就平衡了，贫困和饥饿也被消灭，因为所有失业者都去当农民，吃着花生酱配桃子果酱三明治。1月21日，苏联把全部领土割让给美国，并宣布解散政府。最重要的是，吉米·卡特领导下的政府如今获得了空前的信任；他在1981年电视直播中痛揍理查德·尼克松，赢得99%的支持率。蒙代尔刚刚在最新一届选举中，以873张选举人票对0票，击败了那些可怜的共和党人，共和党不久后就解散了。多亏我们伟大的领袖吉米·卡特，世界一片美好。

revisions.source: Congratulations! You won the 1976 election!
revisions.zh: 恭喜！你赢得了1976年选举！

revisions.source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. They'll need to tread carefully, as the impressive turnaround from 72, despite the playboy interview, shows what America thinks of Ol' Dick Nixon's cronies.
revisions.zh: 恭喜！你虽然从一开始就是热门，却也有好几种可能栽跟头的方式。你承载着国家的意愿，向华盛顿那些圈内人发出了明确讯息。他们必须小心行事：尽管有《花花公子》采访风波，你仍让民主党从1972年的惨败中强势翻身，表明了美国人如何看待老迪克·尼克松的亲信们。

revisions.source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in a number of ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. As expected, your Playboy interview prevented a glorious decimation of the Republicans, but you'll take it, seeing as it could have been worse with the economic recovery.
revisions.zh: 恭喜！你虽然从一开始就是热门，却也有不少可能栽跟头的方式。你承载着国家的意愿，向华盛顿那些圈内人发出了明确讯息。正如预料，《花花公子》采访妨碍了你以辉煌的压倒性优势击败共和党。不过，你还是会接受这个结果，毕竟随着经济复苏，情况本可能更糟。

revisions.source: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. Many were shocked at the tightness of the election, seeing as the negativity around the GOP and DC in general. Maybe you were TOO honest, Jimmy...
revisions.zh: 恭喜！你虽然从一开始就是热门，却也有好几种可能栽跟头的方式。你承载着国家的意愿，向华盛顿那些圈内人发出了明确讯息。鉴于公众对共和党和整个华盛顿政界的不满，选举竟如此接近，让许多人震惊。吉米，也许你太诚实了……

revisions.source: Interestingly enough, Ford ended up winning the popular vote. Republicans are more shocked than angry. Perhaps passing a new version of the Bayh-Celler amendment can be among your reforms?
revisions.zh: 有意思的是，福特最终赢得了普选票。共和党人更多是震惊，而不是愤怒。或许，推动一个新版的贝赫—塞勒修正案，可以成为你改革的一部分？

revisions.source: You still have many options, despite your defeat, as your jolt to the Democrats nomination and the new focus on character in politics will allow you to expand your horizons. While you might not run for president again in four years, a Senate seat in Georgia could suit you very well. Returning to the governor of the state also is possible. Perhaps all the campaigning and stress will inspire you to return to your peanut farm.
revisions.zh: 即使落败，你仍有许多选择。你突然闯入民主党提名争夺，加上政治中重新强调品格，都能让你拓展新的道路。即便四年后不再竞选总统，佐治亚州的一个参议院席位也很适合你。重返州长职位同样有可能。也许，竞选中的奔波和压力，会让你想回到花生农场。

revisions.source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. He will have 4 more years to slash inflation and defend his reputation. He will have to be cautious and show restraint, as you came close to beating him. He with have the public breathing down his neck and Watergate looming over him for his term.
revisions.zh: 公众就是觉得你不能胜任。这是推出你这样一个华盛顿局外人参选的代价，而天平最终倾向了福特。他将再有四年时间降低通胀、捍卫声誉。他必须谨慎克制，因为你差点击败了他。整个任期，公众都会紧盯着他，水门事件也会如影随形。

revisions.source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. Many Democrats are wondering if Watergate might have affected the Republicans more than DC as a  whole, and more standard Democrats could have won this. certainly, your Playboy scandal makes them question nominating someone few people knew.
revisions.zh: 公众就是觉得你不能胜任。这是推出你这样一个华盛顿局外人参选的代价，而天平最终倾向了福特。许多民主党人正在想：水门事件是否对共和党的伤害比对整个华盛顿更大，换一个更常规的民主党候选人是否就能获胜。你的《花花公子》风波，当然让他们怀疑提名一个鲜为人知的人是否明智。

revisions.source: The public just didn't think you were up to the task. That's the tradeoff with running a DC outsider like yourself, and the scale tipped in Fords' favour. Lots of Democrats are incredibly angered that you could lose by such a margin, and are accusing you of throwing away the presidency with a single interview.
revisions.zh: 公众就是觉得你不能胜任。这是推出你这样一个华盛顿局外人参选的代价，而天平最终倾向了福特。许多民主党人对你竟输得如此惨烈极为愤怒，指责你凭一场采访就把总统宝座拱手丢掉了。

revisions.source: If it wasn't already bad enough for you, the popular votes ended up going in your favour. The public and the Democrats are enraged and in despair, as the will of the people to remove the man who pardon Nixon failed. If the Bayh-Celler amendment didn't pass previously, surely the support to pass it will be present now?
revisions.zh: 更糟的是，你最终反而赢得了普选票。公众和民主党既愤怒又绝望：人民希望赶走那个赦免尼克松的人的意愿，竟然落空了。贝赫—塞勒修正案此前没能通过，这次总该有足够支持了吧？

revisions.source: Your quick thrusting into the political limelight and downfall was certainly dramatic. It's up to you what you do next. Perhaps a return to the house, although maybe not in a leadership role. A run in fours years is unlikely with Reagan and his coalition ready to nominate him. Perhaps he might extend an olive branch to you as you did to the conservatives this election, and consider you for his vice presidency?
revisions.zh: 你突然被推到政治聚光灯下，又骤然跌落，实在戏剧性十足。接下来做什么，由你决定。或许可以重返众议院，尽管未必还能担任领导职位。四年后再参选的可能性不大，里根及其支持者联盟已经准备好推举他了。或许他会像你这次向保守派示好一样，向你伸出橄榄枝，考虑让你担任他的副总统？

revisions.source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. The recovering economy, however, made this election quite close, so you can take solace in the fact that you went down swinging.
revisions.zh: 尽管竭尽全力，你还是败给了吉米·卡特，成为唯一一位从未通过选举进入白宫的总统。水门事件和越南战争造成的负担，实在让你难以承受。不过，正在复苏的经济让选举非常接近。你可以安慰自己：至少你一直战斗到了最后。

revisions.source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. America showed they wanted an outsider, and Carter managed to take that title. Let's hope he can help restore faith in government, and help the inflation die down.
revisions.zh: 尽管竭尽全力，你还是败给了吉米·卡特，成为唯一一位从未通过选举进入白宫的总统。水门事件和越南战争造成的负担，实在让你难以承受。美国表明自己想要一个局外人，而卡特成功占据了这个位置。希望他能恢复民众对政府的信任，让通胀降下来。

revisions.source: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. Your Watergate pardon might go down as one of the most blunderous moves in political history, as otherwise, you might have been able to disassociate yourself with Nixon. You, accordingly, got beaten by a larger than expected margin.
revisions.zh: 尽管竭尽全力，你还是败给了吉米·卡特，成为唯一一位从未通过选举进入白宫的总统。水门事件和越南战争造成的负担，实在让你难以承受。你对尼克松的赦免，可能会被视为政治史上最严重的失策之一，否则你也许能与尼克松撇清关系。因此，你遭遇了比预料更大的败选差距。

revisions.source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You won by a quite shocking margin. It seems your rose garden strategy worked well.
revisions.zh: 哇！你顶住不利局势，击退民主党，为本党又赢得一个任期。赦免尼克松后，多数人都以为你完了，但你证明他们错了。你的获胜优势大得令人震惊。看来，你的玫瑰园策略奏效了。

revisions.source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. Carter put up a strong fight, however, and without the Playboy scandal, you likely wouldn't have won. The Democrats are sure to make some electoral changes after two outsiders in a row preventing them from winning...
revisions.zh: 哇！你顶住不利局势，击退民主党，为本党又赢得一个任期。赦免尼克松后，多数人都以为你完了，但你证明他们错了。不过，卡特奋力一战；要是没有《花花公子》风波，你很可能赢不了。连续两位局外人阻碍民主党获胜之后，他们肯定会推动一些选举改革……

revisions.source: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You barely squeaked by, however. Carter gave you a run for your money, and congress isn't too friendly towards you either, so you better tread carefully.
revisions.zh: 哇！你顶住不利局势，击退民主党，为本党又赢得一个任期。赦免尼克松后，多数人都以为你完了，但你证明他们错了。不过，你只是勉强险胜。卡特让你打得十分吃力，国会对你也不太友好，你最好小心行事。

revisions.source: You can hopefully expand upon the recovery from stagflation in your second term, and hopefully bring honour back to the white house. It won't be an easy feat with your pardon, but America wants to give you a chance. Do well and you might be remembered for more than Nixon's pardon.
revisions.zh: 希望你能在第二个任期进一步推动经济摆脱滞胀，恢复白宫的尊严。赦免尼克松使这件事并不容易，但美国愿意给你一个机会。干得好，人们记住你的，就不只会是对尼克松的赦免。

revisions.source: You have selected Walter Mondale as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
revisions.zh: 你选择了沃尔特·蒙代尔作为竞选搭档。能再谈谈这项选择吗？

revisions.source: What will be your overall campaign strategy this year?
revisions.zh: 今年，你的总体竞选策略是什么？

revisions.source: A lot of voters are concerned about honesty and integrity in our government. What can you say about yourself in this aspect?
revisions.zh: 许多选民关心政府的诚实与廉正。在这方面，你有什么可以介绍自己的？

revisions.source: What is your position on the federal government making loans to states or cities in need of financial help? An obvious recent example is the $2.3 billion bailout of New York city.
revisions.zh: 你对联邦政府向需要财政帮助的州或城市提供贷款持什么立场？最近一个明显的例子，是向纽约市提供23亿美元救助。

revisions.source: What is your opinion on abortion, and specifically the recent Roe v. Wade decision?
revisions.zh: 你对堕胎，尤其是最近的罗诉韦德案判决，有何看法？

revisions.source: Would you support a law for universal health care in this country?
revisions.zh: 你会支持在美国建立全民医疗保障的法律吗？

revisions.source: Do you support the Humphrey-Hawkins Full Employment Act?
revisions.zh: 你支持《汉弗莱—霍金斯充分就业法案》吗？

revisions.source: What is your opinion on the court-ordered busing of students within school districts, in a way designed to achieve racial balance in our schools?
revisions.zh: 你对法院命令学区通过校车接送学生、以实现学校种族构成平衡，有何看法？

revisions.source: Do you believe that the United States can afford a reduction in defense spending?
revisions.zh: 你认为美国承受得起削减国防支出吗？

revisions.source: What is your position on a pardon of Vietnam War draft evaders?
revisions.zh: 对于赦免逃避越南战争征兵者，你持什么立场？

revisions.source: Do you support the ratification of the Equal Rights Amendment, which states "Equality of rights under the law shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex."?
revisions.zh: 你支持批准《平等权利修正案》吗？该修正案规定：“美国或任何州，不得因性别而否认或限制法律之下的平等权利。”

revisions.source: In the next issue of Playboy, there's an interview where you used the words "screw" and "shack up" and confessed, "I've committed adultery in my heart..." Many of your religious supporters are furious. What can you say to explain yourself?
revisions.zh: 下一期《花花公子》将刊登对你的采访，你在其中使用了“干”和“姘居”这样的词，还坦言：“我在心里犯过奸淫……”许多信教的支持者愤怒不已。你能怎样解释？

revisions.source: In your infamous Playboy interview, you also referred to Lyndon Johnson as "lying, cheating, and distorting the truth." This might make you look honest, but it could destroy your chances of winning Texas if you don't apologize.
revisions.zh: 在那场声名狼藉的《花花公子》采访中，你还说林登·约翰逊“撒谎、欺骗、歪曲真相”。这也许让你显得诚实，但如果不道歉，就可能毁掉你赢得得克萨斯州的机会。

revisions.source: There is talk of a Presidential Debate for the first time since 1960. Is this something that you're interested in doing?
revisions.zh: 有人提出举行自1960年以来首次总统辩论。你有兴趣参加吗？

revisions.source: You've recently appeared with George Wallace, infamous Governor of Alabama, on the campaign trail. What do you have to say about that?
revisions.zh: 最近，你与臭名昭著的亚拉巴马州州长乔治·华莱士一同出现在竞选活动中。你对此有什么要说的？

revisions.source: General George Brown, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, has made some comments that Israel has become a "burden" to the national defense effort. Do you agree with this?
revisions.zh: 参谋长联席会议主席乔治·布朗将军发表了一些言论，称以色列已成为国防工作的“负担”。你赞同吗？

revisions.source: What are your feelings in the Gregg v. Georgia case, recently decided, that allows capital punishment in the U.S.?
revisions.zh: 最近裁决的格雷格诉佐治亚州案允许美国实行死刑。你对这个案件有何看法？

revisions.source: What is your position on right-to-work laws? Would you support a national bill to repeal Taft-Hartley and do away with right-to-work?
revisions.zh: 你对工作权法持什么立场？你会支持通过全国性法案，废除《塔夫脱—哈特利法》，取消工作权法吗？

revisions.source: Should there be a ban on nuclear weapons testing?
revisions.zh: 是否应禁止核武器试验？

revisions.source: Could we have done more to save South Vietnam in 1975, such as air strikes or a limited engagement?
revisions.zh: 1975年，我们是否本可以做得更多，以挽救南越，例如实施空袭或有限军事介入？

revisions.source: How can we best prevent another episode like the 1973 oil crisis, which paralyzed the country?
revisions.zh: 如何才能最有效地防止1973年石油危机那样、让全国陷入瘫痪的事件重演？

revisions.source: The United States started selling large amounts of grain to the Soviet Union, in 1973. What is your opinion on this policy?
revisions.zh: 美国从1973年开始向苏联大量出售粮食。你对这项政策有何看法？

revisions.source: In 1972, George McGovern proposed replacing the income tax exemption with a $1,000 guaranteed minimum income, for every American citizen. Are you interested in this type of proposal?
revisions.zh: 1972年，乔治·麦戈文提议取消所得税免税额，改为向每个美国公民提供1000美元的最低收入保障。你对这类提议有兴趣吗？

revisions.source: On the Sunday before election day, your church has canceled its services rather than admit a black minister as a member. Will you terminate your own membership?
revisions.zh: 选举日前的那个星期日，你的教会宁愿取消礼拜，也不接纳一位黑人牧师成为成员。你会退出教会吗？

revisions.source: Where will you focus your efforts on the last day before the election?
revisions.zh: 在选举前的最后一天，你会把精力集中在哪里？

revisions.source: People want an outsider in government. I'm in a unique position to unite the country and move it towards a newer, more open chapter in its history.
revisions.zh: 人民希望政府里有个局外人。我处在一个独特的位置，能够团结国家，引领它进入历史上一个崭新、更加开放的篇章。

revisions.source: I know a lot of Democrats are concerned that I'm too moderate. I will make it a point to express support for a staunch liberal platform this fall.
revisions.zh: 我知道，许多民主党人担心我过于温和。我会在秋季竞选中明确支持坚定的自由派纲领。

revisions.source: I won my party's nomination as a moderate, conciliatory politician. We will continue this strategy in the general election, and above all we'll avoid the mistakes of McGovern in '72.
revisions.zh: 我以温和、寻求和解的政治家形象赢得党内提名。大选中，我们会延续这一策略，尤其要避免麦戈文1972年的错误。

revisions.source: Gerald Ford pardoned Nixon, vetoed a school lunch program, and selected Bob Dole as his running mate. We need to remind the American people that he is far too much of a conservative insider to be President.
revisions.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特赦免了尼克松，否决了一个学校午餐项目，还选择鲍勃·多尔作为搭档。我们必须提醒美国人民，他是个过于保守的圈内人，不适合当总统。

revisions.source: I will never tell a lie to the American people. My Southern Baptist faith and my family have guided me for my entire life. I will make sure my biography and home town get heavy coverage in our advertisements.
revisions.zh: 我绝不会向美国人民撒谎。我的美南浸信会信仰和家庭，指引了我的一生。我会确保广告大篇幅介绍我的经历和家乡。

revisions.source: Honesty and integrity is good, but voters want to hear about solutions. I have common-sense answers to our nation's problems.
revisions.zh: 诚实与廉正当然好，但选民想听的是解决办法。对于国家的问题，我有符合常识的答案。

revisions.source: We have a President in the White House who pardoned the most notorious liar in our nation's history. The previous President, Lyndon Johnson, lied our country into Vietnam. I will be a different kind of President.
revisions.zh: 如今白宫里的总统，赦免了美国历史上最臭名昭著的骗子。再前一位总统林登·约翰逊，则用谎言把我国拖进了越南战争。我会成为一位不同的总统。

revisions.source: Not really. We're starting this campaign with a huge lead. I'd rather not roll the dice on that.
revisions.zh: 不太想。竞选刚开始，我们就遥遥领先。我宁愿不拿这个冒险。

revisions.source: I think this is a good idea that will show I'm serious about openness in government.
revisions.zh: 我认为这是个好主意，能表明我认真对待政府的公开透明。

revisions.source: Anyone can see that I am a strong supporter of Civil Rights. I don't agree with what Wallace did, but my campaign is about healing this nation and bringing all sides together to face the future.
revisions.zh: 谁都看得出，我坚定支持民权。我不赞同华莱士过去的所作所为，但我的竞选着眼于弥合国家的创伤，让各方携手面对未来。

revisions.source: I've appeared with George Wallace, just the same as I've appeared with any other Democrat who sought our nomination this year. People don't need to read any special significance into this.
revisions.zh: 我和乔治·华莱士一同露面，就像我与今年其他争取本党提名的民主党人一同露面一样。人们不必从中解读什么特别含义。

revisions.source: We might have our differences, but we have both been the Governors of Southern states, and it is important for us to show our camaraderie.
revisions.zh: 我们或许意见不同，但都曾担任南方州的州长。让人们看到我们彼此友好，很重要。

revisions.source: I think the interview speaks for itself. We need to focus on the issues and not on tabloid gossip.
revisions.zh: 我认为，采访本身已经说得很清楚。我们应关注实际议题，而不是小报八卦。

revisions.source: I will apologize and admit that Playboy was not the best forum to discuss my Christian faith.
revisions.zh: 我会道歉，并承认《花花公子》不是讨论基督教信仰的最佳场合。

revisions.source: I was trying to have an honest conversation about the challenges of living a righteous life. I think once people stop and think about it, they will understand that.
revisions.zh: 我只是想坦诚谈谈过正直生活时面临的挑战。我想，人们只要停下来想一想，就会理解。

revisions.source: I meant what I said, and it's unfortunate that it has to be a big issue with some folks. But I told the American people, "I will never tell a lie."
revisions.zh: 我说的就是我的真实想法。遗憾的是，有些人非要把它闹成大事。但我已经告诉美国人民：“我绝不会撒谎。”

revisions.source: Playboy definitely twisted these words to make them worse than they were. I will apologize profusely to the Johnson family and clarify this statement.
revisions.zh: 《花花公子》确实歪曲了这些话，让它们比原来更难听。我会郑重向约翰逊家人道歉，并澄清这番话。

revisions.source: I've always believed in trying to change an institution from within. My family has consistently voted against segregation in our church, and will continue to do so.
revisions.zh: 我一直相信，应努力从内部改变一个机构。我们家在教会始终投票反对种族隔离，今后也会继续这样做。

revisions.source: Our church has been open to some black attendees in the past, but this particular man is already the member of another church, and is clearly a Republican operative.
revisions.zh: 过去，我们教会也曾允许一些黑人参加活动，但这位先生已经是另一所教会的成员，而且显然是共和党的政治工作人员。

revisions.source: My family has tried for many years to work for change in the Plains Baptist Church, but I can see now that we have failed. I have no choice but to withdraw my membership.
revisions.zh: 我们家多年来一直努力推动普莱恩斯浸信会教堂改变，但我现在看得出，我们失败了。我别无选择，只能退出教会。
